column1: now|/naʊ/|adv.|现在；目前|基础|time-basics|right now::现在；立刻;from now on::从现在起|I cannot talk right now because I am driving.::我现在不能说话，因为我正在开车。|From now on, we will keep a copy of every report.::从现在起，我们会保留每份报告的副本。
then|/ðen/|adv.|那时；然后；那么|基础|time-basics|by then::到那时;now and then::偶尔|Finish your notes first, and then close the book.::先完成笔记，然后合上书。|I lived near the river then.::我那时住在河边。

today|/təˈdeɪ/|adv.; n.|今天；当今|基础|time-basics|later today::今天晚些时候;in today's world::在当今世界|The library closes earlier than usual today.::图书馆今天比平时更早关门。|In today's world, information can travel very quickly.::在当今世界，信息可以传播得非常快。

tomorrow|/təˈmɑːroʊ/|adv.; n.|明天；未来|基础|time-basics|tomorrow morning::明天早上;the day after tomorrow::后天|We will discuss the plan tomorrow morning.::我们明天早上讨论这个计划。|Please return the key before tomorrow.::请在明天之前归还钥匙。

yesterday|/ˈjestərdeɪ/|adv.; n.|昨天；昨日|基础|time-basics|yesterday afternoon::昨天下午;the day before yesterday::前天|I left my umbrella at the office yesterday.::我昨天把伞落在办公室了。|The news arrived yesterday afternoon, just before we left.::消息昨天下午传来，就在我们离开之前。
day|/deɪ/|n.|一天；白天；日子|基础|time-basics|every day::每天;day by day::一天天地|I try to read a little every day.::我尽量每天读一点书。|The young plants are growing stronger day by day.::这些幼苗一天天长得更茁壮了。
week|/wiːk/|n.|周；星期|基础|time-basics|last week::上周;once a week::每周一次|We meet once a week to share our progress.::我们每周见一次面，交流进展。|The repair work should be finished within a week.::维修工作应该会在一周内完成。
month|/mʌnθ/|n.|月；一个月的时间|基础|time-basics|next month::下个月;once a month::每月一次|The new exhibition will open next month.::新展览将在下个月开幕。|She visits her grandparents once a month.::她每月去看望祖父母一次。
year|/jɪr/|n.|年；一年|基础|time-basics|every year::每年;all year round::全年|The village holds a music festival every year.::这个村庄每年都会举办音乐节。|This small library is open all year round.::这座小图书馆全年开放。
time|/taɪm/|n.|时间；时刻；次数|基础|time-basics|on time::准时;from time to time::不时|Please allow enough time for the journey.::请为旅途留出足够的时间。|This is the first time I have visited the city.::这是我第一次到这座城市。

first|/fɜːrst/|adj.; adv.; num.|第一；首先；最初|基础|time-basics|at first::起初;first of all::首先|At first, I found the instructions difficult to follow.::起初，我觉得这些说明很难理解。|Check the address first before sending the letter.::寄信之前先核对地址。
last|/læst/|adj.; adv.; v.|最后的；上一个；持续|基础|time-basics|last night::昨晚;at last::终于|The last train leaves at half past eleven.::末班火车十一点半出发。|How long will the meeting last this afternoon?::今天下午的会议会持续多久？
next|/nekst/|adj.; adv.|下一个的；接下来|基础|time-basics|next week::下周;next to::紧挨着|What should we do next after checking the figures?::核对数字之后，我们接下来该做什么？|The bank is next to the post office.::银行紧挨着邮局。

early|/ˈɜːrli/|adj.; adv.|早的；提前；在早期|基础|time-basics|early morning::清晨;arrive early::提早到达|We left early to avoid the heavy traffic.::我们很早就出发了，以避开拥堵的交通。|Early tests showed that the idea might work.::早期测试表明，这个想法可能行得通。
late|/leɪt/|adj.; adv.|迟的；晚；接近末期|基础|time-basics|be late for::迟到;late at night::深夜|The bus was late because of the snow.::由于下雪，公交车晚点了。|Try not to work too late at night.::尽量不要在晚上工作到太晚。

begin|/bɪˈɡɪn/|v.|开始；着手|基础|time-change|begin with::以……开始;begin to understand::开始理解|Let us begin with the simplest part of the problem.::让我们从问题最简单的部分开始。|The course will begin in the first week of March.::课程将在三月的第一周开始。

end|/end/|n.; v.|结束；末尾；使终止|基础|time-change|at the end of::在……末尾;come to an end::结束|There is a short summary at the end of each chapter.::每章末尾都有一段简短总结。|The meeting should end before five o'clock.::会议应该会在五点前结束。

continue|/kənˈtɪnjuː/|v.|继续；持续|基础|time-change|continue to do::继续做;continue with::继续进行|We can continue with the discussion after lunch.::午饭后我们可以继续讨论。|The rain is expected to continue through the night.::预计这场雨将持续整夜。

delay|/dɪˈleɪ/|n.; v.|延误；推迟|基础|time-change|without delay::立即；毫不耽搁;a short delay::短暂延误|Bad weather may delay the arrival of our supplies.::恶劣天气可能会延误物资的到达。|Please report any problem without delay.::发现问题请立即报告。

period|/ˈpɪriəd/|n.|一段时间；时期；句号|基础|time-change|a short period::一小段时间;over a period of::在一段……期间|The changes took place over a period of ten years.::这些变化是在十年间发生的。|Give yourself a short period of rest after work.::工作后给自己安排一小段休息时间。

temporary|/ˈtempəreri/|adj.|暂时的；临时的|基础|time-change|a temporary solution::临时解决办法;temporary work::临时工作|The bridge is closed for temporary repairs.::这座桥因临时维修而关闭。|This measure offers only a temporary solution.::这一措施只能提供临时的解决办法。

permanent|/ˈpɜːrmənənt/|adj.|永久的；长期不变的|基础|time-change|a permanent job::一份长期工作;permanent damage::永久性损伤|They are looking for a permanent place to live.::他们正在寻找长期居住的地方。|The flood caused permanent damage to some buildings.::洪水对一些建筑造成了永久性损坏。

gradual|/ˈɡrædʒuəl/|adj.|逐渐的；渐进的|四级|gradual|a gradual change::渐进的变化;a gradual increase::逐渐增加|Learning a language is usually a gradual process.::学习语言通常是一个渐进的过程。|The report shows a gradual increase in demand.::报告显示需求正在逐渐增加。

gradually|/ˈɡrædʒuəli/|adv.|逐渐地；逐步地|基础|gradual|gradually improve::逐渐改善;gradually disappear::逐渐消失|The noise gradually disappeared as we walked away.::随着我们走远，噪声逐渐消失了。|Her confidence grew gradually with regular practice.::通过经常练习，她的信心逐渐增强了。

frequent|/ˈfriːkwənt/|adj.|频繁的；经常发生的|基础|frequent|frequent changes::频繁的变化;a frequent visitor::常客|Frequent interruptions made it difficult to concentrate.::频繁的打断让人难以集中注意力。|He is a frequent visitor to the local library.::他是当地图书馆的常客。

frequently|/ˈfriːkwəntli/|adv.|频繁地；经常|四级|frequent|frequently asked questions::常见问题;occur frequently::经常发生|This word appears frequently in everyday conversation.::这个词经常出现在日常交谈中。|We check the equipment frequently during the experiment.::实验过程中，我们经常检查设备。

occur|/əˈkɜːr/|v.|发生；出现；被想到|基础|occur|occur to someone::某人想到;occur naturally::自然出现|Small errors can occur when information is copied by hand.::手工抄写信息时可能会出现小错误。|It did not occur to me to check the date.::我当时没有想到要核对日期。

occurrence|/əˈkɜːrəns/|n.|发生；出现；发生的事情|四级|occur|a common occurrence::常见的事;the occurrence of::……的发生|Heavy snow is a common occurrence in this region.::大雪在这一地区是常见的事。|The team recorded the occurrence of each unusual event.::团队记录了每一次异常事件的发生。

sequence|/ˈsiːkwəns/|n.|顺序；一连串；序列|四级|sequ|in sequence::按顺序;a sequence of events::一连串事件|Arrange the pictures in the correct sequence.::把图片按正确顺序排列。|The article describes the sequence of events before the accident.::文章描述了事故发生前的一连串事件。

consequence|/ˈkɑːnsəkwens/|n.|结果；后果；重要性|基础|sequ|as a consequence::因此;a serious consequence::严重后果|Every decision may have a consequence we did not expect.::每个决定都可能带来我们意想不到的后果。|The road was closed, and as a consequence we arrived late.::道路封闭了，因此我们迟到了。
